title: Effective fpqc descent for quasi-affine scheme morphisms
statement: Let $p:A\to B$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] whose one-member family is an fpqc covering [def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering]. Let $V\to A$ be a quasi-affine morphism [def-nagata-quasi-affine-morphism]: the inverse image of each affine open in $A$ is a quasi-affine scheme, meaning a quasi-compact open subscheme of an affine scheme. Let $\phi:V\times_B A\xrightarrow{\sim}A\times_B V$ be an isomorphism over $A\times_B A$ satisfying $\phi_{02}=\phi_{12}\circ\phi_{01}$ on $A\times_B A\times_B A$ [def-pc-fibre-product, def-pd-descent-datum]. Then this datum is effective: there exist a scheme $V_0\to B$ and an isomorphism $V_0\times_B A\simeq V$ over $A$ inducing $\phi$. No local finite-presentation hypothesis on $V\to A$ is imposed. All schemes are in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention].
